title: Give a Gift of Membership
html:
The IAOMS Gift Membership allows IAOMS members and non-members to give the gift of IAOMS membership to a colleague, student or resident.  Support the next generation of oral and maxillofacial surgeons. IAOMS gift memberships are a meaningful graduation, holiday or birthday gift.

In two easy steps, you can give the gift (or gifts) of membership and help build a career and our profession.

  1. Complete the Give a Gift form.
  2. Submit the Give a Gift form to Katie Cairns at kcairns@iaoms.org.

 

Give a Gift of Membership

 

Fellow: Established OMF surgeon (required credentialing for new IAOMS Fellows).

  • $240 One Year Membership

 

Associate: Non-OMF surgeon or non-surgeon in a related field.

  • $240 USD One Year Membership

 

Trainees who completed their OMFS training and are in their first two years as an established OMF surgeon (required credentialing). 

  • $72 USD Graduated Trainee to Fellow Year 1
  • $144 USD Graduated Trainee to Fellow Year 2

 

OMFS Trainee: Available exclusively for those in oral and maxillofacial surgery training and requires verification of trainee status. OMFS Trainees are required to complete Trainee Verification Form.  

  • $45 USD One Year Membership (includes IJOMS online access)
  • $25 USD One Year Membership (no access to IJOMS)
     

Associate Trainee: Available for non-OMF surgery trainees or trainees in fields related to OMFS (e.g., trainees in dentistry, oral surgery, etc.).
